name: sonzai-claude-skill
description: Two plugins for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) building on the Sonzai SDK: (1) sonzai-sdk (public) — wizard skill for human-in-the-loop builds + full-auto skill for autonomous closed-loop builds from a meeting transcript with API + UI verification; (2) sonzai-internal-staff (install-time-gated, opt-in) — monolith awareness extension for Sonzai staff dogfooding. Covers 7 archetypes across Python, TypeScript, and Go. Wizard prescribes runtime mode (full-chat vs memory-layer via sessions vs memory-layer via /process) and BYOK as the production posture. v1.5.0 split a single runtime-gated plugin into two install-time-gated plugins so public users no longer get the internal-staff files copied to disk.
